dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: The way I see it, the use of force to subdue one's foes should always be a last resort.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: With enough careful planning and preparation, you can set things up so that by the time you have to confront your enemy, they fall to pieces in your hands. Saves a lot of time that way.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, the tables are turned on us here. We're the challengers, and the one pulling the strings is hiding out of our reach.
